description:
Scope-expansion child carved from specled_-dn4.8 (both graders named the same out-of-scope blocker; audit comment 2026-07-25T13:42:16Z).

dn4.8's gate-forced verifier.ex change (exempting change_type: deprecates affects from decision_unknown_affect) made the live must specled.decisions.reference_validation (decision_governance.spec.md:41-44, 'The verifier shall reject ADR affects or supersession links that do not resolve', no carve-out) FALSE of the verifier for deprecates ADRs. The exemption itself is correct — cross_field_affects_resolve (:96-104) states it affirmatively and CrossField implements it — but the older general sentence was never updated, carries no realized_by binding, and no mechanical detector fires on requirement-text narrowing, so this drift survives only if ticketed.

Work:
1. Add the 'except change_type: deprecates' carve-out to reference_validation's statement.
2. Decide whether the verifier's affect exemption should stay deprecates-only or widen to append_only's full weakening set (deprecates|weakens|narrows-scope|adds-exception) — currently narrower than the ceremony's authorizing set; document the decision either way.
3. Append-only consideration: adding the carve-out narrows a live must's scope; narrows-scope is in @weakening_set (append_only.ex:31). No current detector fires on requirement-text narrowing, but do the ceremony honestly — author an ADR if the specled.decisions owner judges it a weakening.

Allowed touches: .spec/specs/decision_governance.spec.md, .spec/decisions/ (new ADR if needed), lib/specled_ex/verifier.ex + test/specled_ex/verifier_test.exs (ONLY if decision 2 widens the exemption), .spec/realization_hashes.json, CHANGELOG.md.
Out of scope: everything else; especially do not touch the dn4.8 deliverables.

Advances: specled.decisions (decision_governance.spec.md). MUST land before the epic PR is cut (the same-PR invariant for spec+code consistency is satisfied at the epic merge boundary).
title: Advance specled.decisions: add change_type:deprecates carve-out to reference_validation; align verifier exemption breadth
